projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: 1 SaaS in production · 4 active paying clients · 1 technical showcase

coldmail.tagline: B2B SaaS platform for large-scale cold mailing with automated domain warming, analytical conversion funnel dashboard and intelligent lead scoring by temperature. Includes campaign management, templates, LinkedIn integration and scheduled outreach.

btBarber.tagline: Multi-tenant SaaS system for barbershops with three specialized interfaces: client for online booking, barber for schedule management and admin for operations management. Includes integrated e-commerce module for product sales, ratings system and timetable.

bancoAgil.tagline: Multi-agent banking customer service system with four specialized AI agents covering triage, credit analysis, currency exchange and financial profile. RAG architecture with OpenAI, CPF identity validation and contextual conversational routing between agents.

experience.title: Career timeline
experience.subtitle: The milestones and achievements that shape my journey so far.

bullets: FinTech for financial transactions: PIX, TED, card processing and USDT (crypto) operations.
Python back-end services on AWS Lambda; CI/CD on Azure DevOps in a regulated environment.
Focus on transaction validation, retry with backoff, observability and core security.
End-to-end ownership of own SaaS products: requirements, architecture, database, Vercel/AWS deployment and ongoing maintenance.
Customer acquisition and onboarding alongside technical development, owning product, support and billing.
N8N automations integrating external APIs (LinkedIn, email, webhooks) and OpenAI-based AI flows.
Promoted to Mid-Level in 2025 for consistent delivery and technical merit, after 3 years at the company.
Microservices with DDD and SOLID; bounded contexts and separation of concerns in Node.js/NestJS and C# .NET APIs.
REST/Webhook integrations with WhatsApp Business and Instagram Graph API; multi-tenant CRM support.
CI/CD pipelines on Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps; staging environment with smoke tests.

fcs.company: FCS — Fluxo de Caixa Simples (AR Digital Labs)
bullets: FinTech for SMB financial management, with cash flow, reconciliation and reporting.
Serverless back-end in .NET Core on AWS Lambda; cold starts mitigated via warm-up scheduler.
SQL query refactoring with index analysis and N+1 fixes; performance gains on critical dashboards.

skills.title: Back-end is my specialty. Full stack is my practice.

architecture.title: Software Architecture
architecture.summary: I think the system before coding. How will it scale? Where does it break first? How does it evolve without a rewrite?
architecture.body: DDD with bounded contexts, SOLID separation across microservices, asynchronous communication with queues, Kubernetes orchestration, events vs commands (CQRS where it fits).

product.title: Product Sense
product.summary: I understand the business problem before choosing the technical solution. Code serves the product, not the other way around.
product.body: Stakeholder conversations, reading metrics and competition, impact-prioritized proposals. I have built 2 of my own SaaS products from idea to paying customer.

production.title: Production & Reliability
production.summary: Shipping a system is one stage; keeping it running in production is another. I work with observability, resilience and the continuous care that environment requires.
production.body: Transaction validations, retry with exponential backoff, idempotency, structured logging, serverless cold start mitigation, staging smoke tests, error observability.

leadership.title: Technical Leadership
leadership.summary: I led a team of developers, with sprints, tasks, dailies and delivery responsibility.
leadership.body: Running weekly sprints, planning and breaking down board tasks, dailies, code reviews and technical onboarding of junior developers in a corporate contract environment.

ai.title: Applied AI & Automation
ai.summary: Currently going deeper into SDD (Spec-Driven Development), RAG, architecture and agent engineering. Focused on AI as part of the product architecture, with well-designed context.
ai.body: Multi-step agents with OpenAI, RAG architecture with knowledge bases, context validation, conversational routing between specialized agents, N8N automations integrating external APIs.

contact.subtitle: Response within 24h on business days. Open to technical interviews, exploratory chats or a virtual coffee.
